tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ sha brgya zan brgya'i glud bsngo ba'i cho ga zangs yag brag gi gter ma bzhugs so: gu ru jo tse'i gter byon :

na mo gu ru: bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: gdams pa 'di ni: ban bon gyi byad kha chen po zug pa'am: yang na ban bon dang kha 'gras pa'i mthu gtad ngan sngags byas pa yod pa la 'di bsngags: phyugs lug god kha sogs gdon ngos ma zin na kun la 'di bsngags so gsungs nas: rgya bod kyi so mtshams su: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad de gter du sbas: gu ru jo tses zangs yag brag ri'i gter nas bton pa'o: padma'i chos brgyud 'dzin pa ma gtogs dam tshig med pa'i mi log lta can la yig cha mi ston pa dam tshig go: 'di'i lag len la: sha brgya zan brgya changs brgya: spre'u dang g.yag khal rta drel khal: dar zab la sogs bzo ras: khrab la sogs 'bul ba bkal ba bya'o: gzhan yang sran ma bra'o til zar ma la sogs 'bru sna gang 'dzom: rin po che'i sder mar blugs la chang phud gtsang ma byas la glud du bsngo ba ni: dang po rang gi yi dam gang mos dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed: sngags drug phyag drug gis byin rlabs byas nas byams snying rje'i ngang nas bsngo ba ni: rnga brdung zhing rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas 'di skad do: hūm̐: dang po rgyal byung gang nas byung : dang po rgya yi yul nas byung : de nas rgyal bab gang du babs: mi yul skyi mthing de ru babs: de nas rgyal babs gang du babs: bdud las byung ba'i rgyal po de ru babs: de nas rgyal babs gang du babs: bcom ldan thub pa'i dgra bcom de la babs: de nas rgyal babs gang du babs: rgyal po 'khor lo drug pa de la babs: de nas rgyal babs gang du babs: rgyal po kri kri de la babs: de nas rgyal babs gang du babs: rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan de la babs: de nas rgyal babs gang du babs: bod kyi rgyal po de la babs: de nas rgyal babs gang du babs: rngon pa mi bdun de la babs: de nas rgyal babs gang du babs: de ring rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'di la babs:

de ring gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren na: steng gi phyogs nas lha yi dbang po brgya byin yang : rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gyis: gnas 'dir ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: 'og gi phyogs nas spyan 'dren na: dga' bo 'jog po la sogs pa: klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: bcom ldan rigs gsum mgon po yang : rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren no: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: rgya gar yul gyi rig 'dzin sgrub pa po: rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren no: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: bal po'i yul gyi rig 'dzin sgrub pa po: rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren no: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: bod kyi yul nas rig 'dzin sgrub pa po: rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: phyi nang srung ma dam tshig can: rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: phyi nang pho nya sum brgya drug cu yang : rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: nang rdo rje rigs kyi pho nya sum brgya drug cu yang : rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: g.ya' dang gangs la gnas pa yi: sman dgu la sogs thams cad kyang : rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:

sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: yul gyi yul lha gnyan po yang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: rgyal po sum brgya drug cu yang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na: gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs ra ba gang gi glud du 'bul: bdud po sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs ra ba gang gi glud du 'bul: rje bdud lha btsan 'khor dang bcas: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: glud chen bzang po 'di bzhes la: mi bdud dar du ma bsad cig: rta bdud bres su ma bsad cig: g.yag bdud gdong du ma bsad cig: bya bdud gdang du ma bsad cig: srog bdag srid pa'i rgyal po yang : rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol:

ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: byang shar btsan rgod dmar po yang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: nyi zla la sogs gza' chen brgyad: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs ra ba gang gi glud du 'bul: tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs kyang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: smin drug snar ma la sogs pa'i: rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: rdo rje legs pa la sogs pa'i: the'u rang sum brgya drug cu yang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: ma bdud byang sman rgyal mo yang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul:

bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: lcags mo gangs dkar rgyal mo yang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: phyogs bzhi'i rgyal chen sde bzhi yang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: rgyal phran sum brgya drug cu yang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: brag btsan klu btsan la sogs kyang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: btsan phran sum brgya drug cu yang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs rwa ba gang gi glud du 'bul: yul 'di'i yul lha gnyan po yang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol:

ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu yang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyod kyis bzhes su gsol: 'gal 'khrul nongs pa ci mchis pa: mthol zhing bshags so bzod par gsol: sha brgya zan brgya'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyis: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon 'bul: 'bul bas khyed kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs rwa ba gang gi glud du 'bul: chag che nyam nga bzlog tu gsol: su dang 'phrad pa de la sgyur: ces nad pa sogs la byed na glud bdun nam lnga la bya'o: phur kha zlog na bshos bu khrag byug pa brgyad dam bdun gang rigs la bsang sbyang byin rlabs drag sngags bzlas shing phyogs bzhir 'phang : ngag tu 'di skad brjod: ba/tomathab/sha: bhyo: bdag la phur kha gtong ba zlog: gzhan gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa zlog: gshin rje'i khram kha zug pa zlog: bon po'i rbad 'dre 'di yis zlog: mu stegs ngan sngags 'di yis zlog: pha rol rbad 'dre 'di yis zlog: sngags pa'i sngags zor 'di yis zlog: zhang zhung btso zor 'di yis zlog: bud med dmod zor 'di yis zlog: rgya gar ngan sngags 'di yis zlog: brgyal nad smyo 'bog 'di yis zlog: btsan gyi gzer kha 'di yis zlog: sum pa'i byol zor 'di yis zlog: klu yi nad rigs btang ba zlog: sman gyi bro ra chas pa zlog: gdags srib spyang ki ngu ba zlog: dur khrod wa mo brgyal ba zlog: srin bya lha khang khus 'debs zlog: 'ug pa ha ha zer ba zlog:

sgo khyi ngu zug byed pa zlog: nam gung 'og rta mtsher ba zlog: byis pa'i kha brda ngan pa zlog: lo kag zla kag 'di yis zlog: lo sri zla sri 'di yis zlog: zhag kag zla kag 'di yis zlog: mi kha bra mchu 'di yis zlog: 'di yis mi zlog gang yang med: dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' ma bcag: yon bdag 'di yi 'gal rkyen thams cad phyir zlog cig: gzhan yang zlog pa'i tshig brjod la gtor ma phyogs bzhir bskyal lo: ༈ 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ o rgyan padma 'byung gnas/ gter ston jo tse nas brgyud dkar po kun dga' grags pa// dbon po yon tan bzang po/ des bya lha mchog bzang po/ yug pa jo drung yab sras/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ grub chen klong yangs pa/ des bdag la'o/ ༈ 'di'i lag len dmar khrid kyi sogs ni/ shar du spre'u dkar po la khal bkal ba keng rus kyis ded mi/ lhor rta dmar gyi khal dang btsun pa zhwa dmar can/ nub tu dre'u nag gi khal dang btsun pa zhwa ser gyon pa/ byang du mdzo rog gi khal dang*/ rtogs ldan dom ra can no// khal 'ded mi bzhi po 'bogs khur ba bya'o// bzhi po re re changs bu sha dmar gyis brgyan pa nyer lnga dkyil du glud che ba la la rdzas klung rdzas sna tshogs gang 'byor bsham par bya'o/// /
